name: nutrient
description: Parse, extract from and classify documents with Nutrient DWS: OCR for scans, Markdown with layout, structured fields with citations, and labels, as stored runs in your Nutrient account.

interface.longDescription: For people and teams who work with documents in ChatGPT or Codex: turn PDFs, Office documents and images into Markdown with layout, extract structured fields with citations for the values it finds, and classify documents with Nutrient DWS. Requires a Nutrient DWS account with credits: each run uses credits and is stored in your account. In ChatGPT, Nutrient takes files attached to the chat or HTTPS links; signing, redaction and other Processor operations need files on your computer, as in Codex. Uploaded files are kept for 24 hours.
defaultPrompt: Parse the attached PDF into Markdown with Nutrient
Extract the invoice number, seller and total from this invoice with Nutrient
